content: Bhela, nginyulila ngolongwa jakabhonakini kunani kumahunde. Pakabhili na mbomba joawatikwi lyobha, na mwehi ukabhi pahi ja magholu ghaki na litaji la ndondwa komi na ibheli lakabhi pamutu jaki.
Mbomba hoju akabhi na chitumbo, akaleliki kwa mabhinilu makolongwa ngati mabhinilu gha kulibhopo mwana.
Panihapa, nginyulila jengi jakabhonakini kunani kumahunde. Lingalyaje, kukabhi na lijoka likolongwa likeli na lelibhi na mimutu saba na manyelu komi, na kila mmutu ukabhi na litaji.

Nkela wa lijoka heli ukajoliki selusi jimu ja ndondwa ya kunani na kuileke pundema. Panihapa lijoka heli lakajemiki palongi jaka mbomba joakabhi pambipi kulibhopo mwana, nahuli lipata kummila mwana jola chikahi pela payibhelakikaje.
Mbomba jola akumbeliki mwana nkambaku ambaju anaatawalaje mataifa ghokapi kwa ndonga ja choma. Na mwana hoju akatolakiki na kupelakeka kunani kwaka Chapanga, pa chitehu chaki cha kikolongwa.
Mbomba jola akakembalili kulipololu, pandu ambapu Chapanga akabhi andenganaki wichu, nahuli apata kughohakeka wichu konihoku kwa machobha elufu jimu na mia ibheli na sitini.
Bhela kukabhili na ngondo kunani kumahunde. Mikaeli na bhatumika bhaki bha kunani kumahunde bhakakomini na lijoka lela, papamu na bhatumika bhaki.
Nambu lijoka lela na bhatumika bhaki bhakalepalile, na pandu pabhu ngachepabhonakini kabhete kunani kumahunde.

Bhela, lijoka lela likolongwa lakalekaliki pundema. Lijoka likolongwa lela nde lijoka la mwandi, lelilowakeka Ibilisi au Shetani, lelabhakolowa bhandu bhokapi bha pundema. Akalekaliki pundema, papamu na bhatumika bhaki.

Bhela, nakajowini sauti ngolongwa kuhuma kunani kumahunde, jakapwaghaje, “Sajenu kubhi na ukengaleku, na makili, na Ukolongwa waka Chapanga, na lujiniku lwaka Kristo wake! Maghambu alekaliki pahi mtakila wa bhalongu bhitu, jola joabhatakila bhalongu bhitu palongi jaka Chapanga witu, ikilu na muhe.
Nabhombi bhakunhweziki kwa mwahi waka Mwanambelele, na kwa lilobhi la ulandilu wabhu, ambabhu ngachebhaghapaliki matamu ghabhu mbaka kupotela.

Kwa ndandi jeniheji, muhekalyaje mwenga kunani na mabhokapi mwentama monihomu. Nambu anauchibhonaje ndema na bahali! Maghambu Ibilisi jola ahelili kwinu akabya na inyela ngolongwa, kwa kubha amanyi kubha chikahi chaki chechihighalili nde kichoku pela.”
Na lijoka lela palaweni kubha lilekaliki pundema, lakatumbwi kundonda mbomba jola joakalibhopwi mwana nkambaku.

Mbomba jola akapekiwi mapapanila ghabheli gha ngwahe ngolongwa, nahuli agholukaje kutali nakanopi na lijoka lela, mbaka pandu papalenganakiki kulipololu kwa ndandi jaki, konihoku akaghohakikaje kwa chikahi cha hyaka itatu na nusu.
Bhela, lijoka lela lakatapiki machi ghamaheli ngati nkoka, ghakunjengali mbomba jola nahuli ghunjolaje.
Nambu luhombi lwakunjangati mbomba jola, lukajamiki ngati ndomu, na kughamila machi ghaghakapitiki mundomu ja lijoka hele.

Bhela, lijoka lela lakamuyomili mbomba jola, lakapiti kukomana na bhabhelakeka bhaka mbomba jola bhabhahighalile, yani, bhandu bhokapi bhabhakamula amuli yaka Chapanga, na kutangaza malobhi ghaka Yesu Kristo.
Bhela lijoka lela lakajemiki panani ja luhanga lwa mumaheku gha bahali.
